# apicp_nodes (Data Source)

Lists the nodes enrolled with apicp. Nodes are enrolled by the installer on the node itself, not created through the API, so this is read-only. Use it to pick a `node_id` for `apicp_web_domain` / `apicp_mail_domain`, e.g. `[for n in data.apicp_nodes.all.nodes : n.id if contains(n.roles, "web") && n.connected][0]`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "apicp_nodes" "all" {}

# First connected node that hosts mail.
locals {
  mail_node = [for n in data.apicp_nodes.all.nodes : n.id if contains(n.roles, "mail") && n.connected][0]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Always `nodes`.
- `nodes` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--nodes))

<a id="nestedatt--nodes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `nodes`

Read-Only:

- `agent_version` (String) Version reported by the node's agent.
- `connected` (Boolean) Whether the node's agent is connected right now.
- `enrolled_at` (String) When the node enrolled (RFC3339).
- `hostname` (String) Node hostname.
- `id` (String) Node ID.
- `last_seen_at` (String) When the node was last seen (RFC3339).
- `public_host` (String) Public hostname, if set at enrolment.
- `roles` (Set of String) What the node hosts (e.g. `web`, `mail`, `dns`, `db`).
- `status` (String) Enrolment status.
